**Only `a.log` is excluded by the flag itself.**

- **`a.log` — excluded.** `--exclude-ext=log` is parsed into `exclude_exts` (src/main.zig:1480-1483) and passed to the filter engine (src/main.zig:2432-2434, src/main.zig:2553-2555); `matchesExt` accepts a dotless ext only when the preceding char is `.` (src/filter.zig:302-304).
- **`catalog` — not excluded.** No `.` before "log", so the match fails (src/filter.zig:302-305).
- **`.log` — not excluded by this flag.** The name is exactly ".log", so `name.len > ext.len + 1` is false (src/filter.zig:302). It *is* skipped by default anyway, since `".log"` is in the default excluded list (src/filter.zig:40, src/filter.zig:598-601) — unless `--no-default-ignore`/`--no-ignore` (src/main.zig:2546).
- **`A.LOG` — not excluded.** Matching is case-sensitive `std.mem.endsWith` (src/filter.zig:300,303).
